note: Searched all agent files, including hidden CI configuration, for recovery, replay, retry, checkpoint, resume, audit, idempotency, timeout, backoff, queue and outbox; traced main.py startup and run launch, loop.py, extractor.py child messages, the registry and every tool, mcp_client.py notifications, identity.py token exchange, approvals.py callbacks, ingest.py, budget.py, killswitch.py, settings.py, prompts/config, migrations and deployment/build configuration. Both loops initialize fresh in-memory conversations and consume newly returned model tool calls; no checkpoint loader, audit reader for recovery, saved-operation scheduler or automatic integration resend exists. Audit rows are inserted for observation only. Persistent department notes are factual task data, quotas are counters, and approval decisions update authorization status without resuming or replaying a run. Tool exceptions return an error to the model rather than invoking a retry; a subsequent newly proposed model call is not a harness recovery replay. ERP, Slack, payment and STS clients each issue a single HTTP request per invocation; MCP list-change notifications refresh metadata only. Payment idempotency alone does not establish recovery, and SDK model-request retries would not replay destination tool actions. Kubernetes process replacement starts the same fresh harness without persisted execution state. No logs or checkpoints drive recovery and no automatic replay path was found in the supplied implementation, so R14.1–R14.5 are not applicable.
